items.title: Three-isogeny cohomological characterization of quasi-monogenic relative cubic extensions
items.author: Jordi Guàrdia; Francesc Pedret
items.difficulty_reason: The main criterion requires the index-form genus-one torsor and its three-isogeny Selmer class, explicit Galois cocycles for cubic extensions and elliptic points, and recovery of the cubic field from the corresponding stabilizer/coboundary comparison. Full source-local derivations retained. Old177876 only identifies the index-form curve/Jacobian270–300; it does not give the complete relative-field existential characterization and explicit cocycle matching. OriginalO_Lfree-overO_K hypothesis retained. Quasi-monogenity means aK-rational index-form solution,not an integral power basis; later monogenity computations stay GRH-qualified and uncounted,with no code/table execution.

primary.label: Complete original relative cubic characterization including free integer ring and existential point/field-isomorphism conditions

proof_spans.label: Complete index-form/discriminant and Jacobian setup, Selmer/cohomology classes, explicit cubic-field/point cocycles and both directions of main characterization
